title: 协作光标
summary: 网络只能丢稀疏坐标，协作光标如何平滑跟手？解耦网络采样与屏幕刷新，用二阶弹簧半隐式欧拉积分重建自然惯性与微过冲。
summaryEn: Sparse network packets leave remote cursors stuttering. Decouple network sampling from screen refresh, using second-order semi-implicit Euler spring integration to reconstruct natural momentum and subtle overshoot.
asks: 网络只能丢稀疏坐标，协作光标如何平滑跟手？
asksEn: How should a collaborative cursor track smoothly under sparse network sampling?
